'''Green Scroll''' is an item used to increase {{Icon|Town Quality|size=20}} [[Town Quality]].

== Obtaining ==

* Repair houses and blocks in the [[Town]].

== Uses ==
* Talk to [[Linda]], in the [[Dockside Club]], during {{Icon|Lust|size=25}} to exchange Green Scroll for {{Icon|Town Quality|size=20}}.
